seo.title: Tackle Box Outfitters — Live Bait, Tackle, Licenses & Propane on Lake Texoma · Pottsboro, TX
seo.description: Lake Texoma's one-stop fishing and outdoor headquarters in Pottsboro: year-round shiners, rods, reels and tackle, $12 lake licenses, unleaded and ethanol-free fuel, propane, marine supplies, snacks, drinks and souvenirs.

home.heroKicker: The Most Fishing on Lake Texoma
home.heroTitle: Everything you need for a day on the lake. One stop.
home.heroSubtitle: Year-round shiners, rods, reels and terminal tackle, fishing licenses, unleaded and ethanol-free fuel, propane, marine supplies, lake gear, snacks and hot coffee — on Highway 289 as you head to the water.

intro.title: The last stop before the lake
body: The Tackle Box sits on SH 289 at Tackle Box Drive, the road every angler and camper takes to Lighthouse Resort, Island View and the Preston Peninsula. It stocks shiners year-round, offers unleaded and ethanol-free fuel at the pump, fills propane, and sells the $12 Lake Texoma fishing license to residents and non-residents alike.

Inside: a huge selection of rods, reels, terminal tackle, lures, soft plastics and swimbaits, plus cast nets, landing nets, filet knives, marine fluids, boat and trailer parts, life jackets, water toys, inflatables and tubes. Add souvenirs, shirts, ice, firewood, snacks, cold drinks and always-hot coffee—and the Texoma Destinations team in the same building can help arrange activities, experiences, boat rentals and lodging.

features.title: Live bait
features.body: Shiners year-round, bass and crappie minnows, black salties, worms and glow worms, plus frozen bait and livers. Bait tanks and aerators if you're stocking up for a guide day.

features.title: Striper tackle
features.body: Lures, soft plastics and swimbaits the Texoma guides actually throw, rods and reels, cast nets, landing nets and tackle boxes. Ask what's working — the staff fish here.

features.title: Fishing licenses
features.body: A Lake Texoma license is $12 for residents and non-residents and covers the whole lake, both states. Buy it here in two minutes.

features.title: Propane, ice & firewood
features.body: Cylinder refills any time we're open; RV fills with a quick call ahead. Ice, coolers, firewood and fire starters for the campsite.

features.title: Boat & RV supplies
features.body: Marine oils and fluids, boat and trailer parts, repair and safety equipment, life jackets, RV repair items and hoses—the supplies that save a weekend.

features.title: Book a striper guide
features.body: Texoma is the Striper Capital of the World and the top guides run out of Lighthouse Marina, two minutes up the road. Find one on Texoma Destinations, then stop here for your license and bait.

hubHandoff.title: Guides, cabins and boats are one click away
hubHandoff.body: Texoma Destinations lists the striper guides, Lighthouse cabins and tritoon rentals that turn a bait run into a weekend. TAP members save 5–10% here in the store and a nickel to a dime per gallon at the Lighthouse fuel dock.

plan.title: Visit the store
plan.subtitle: 83924 N State Hwy 289, Pottsboro — as you approach Lighthouse Resort & Marina.

arrival.title: Hours & propane
body: Store hours change with the season. Shiners are stocked year-round, and unleaded and ethanol-free fuel are available at the pump. RV propane fills need a quick heads-up so we can have someone at the tank.
The Tackle Box shares an address with the Texoma Destinations reservation office; if you have a question about a cabin or cruise, the team next door can help.

directions: From Pottsboro take SH 289 north about 5 miles; the Tackle Box is on the right at 83924 N State Hwy 289.
Two minutes before Lighthouse Resort & Marina and Island View Park — stock up before you get to the water.
Trailer parking out front; pull through for propane.
